source.title: Experimental control of morphogenesis in the regulation of Planaria

stage: trunk fragment (postpharyngeal body piece, region between levels 2 and 3 of the first zooid)

intervention.description: Fifty pieces placed in 1.5% (v/v) alcohol for 48 hours after section, then transferred to water.

readout.method: scored for anterior-end (head) type class of each regenerated piece

setup_flags.family_note: scored for head type class rather than polarity directly; alcohol treated as an anesthetic
